activity.notes: Nicolò Vito di Gozze (Nikola Vitov Gučetić) was elected Rector (knez) of the Republic of Ragusa for a one-month term in 1609-06. Ragusan rectors served short rotating terms, so ATLAS records this election as a separate month-level Activity rather than merging his seven rectorships into a continuous reign.

sources.title: Kasnorenesansni filozof Nikola Vitov Gučetić — Ivica Martinović
sources.citation_text: Ivica Martinović's 1997 scholarly study lists Gučetić's seven rectorships by month: October 1589, November 1593, June 1596, April 1600, April 1603, March 1606, and June 1609.

sources.title: GUČETIĆ, Nikola Vitov — Hrvatski biografski leksikon
sources.citation_text: The Croatian Biographical Lexicon confirms that Nikola Vitov Gučetić was elected Rector of the Republic of Ragusa seven times.
